_comment: Running handoff doc 01 for Claude Code to make the visible SIT product shell honest and usable before Copilot performs final deploy/runtime proof.
title: Implement and harden W4 end-to-end SIT product-shell usability
lane: Claude Code - implementation, UI/API wiring, visible-control audit, local proof
objective: Make the current SIT product shell honest and usable end to end. Audit every visible navigation item and primary action, then either wire it to real backend behavior, visibly disable/defer it, or hide it from the SIT review surface. The goal is to eliminate fake-success UI and prepare a local-verified build that Copilot can deploy and prove on live SIT.

do_not_touch: Openclaw deploy workflows unless only reading for context
Unrelated broad redesign outside visible SIT usability
hard_boundary.implementation_rule: This is not a review-only task. Apply the minimal safe repo changes needed so the visible SIT shell is either usable or honestly deferred.

manual_sit_findings: SIT still exposes product-shell actions that feel prototype-only.
Add Company and Add User looked clickable but did not obviously persist real data in manual review.
Company detail COA/AP/AR and settings actions may still include toast-only behavior.
Export/Configurator lane had previous focused proof, but W4 now requires the broader product shell to be honest.
new_design_rule: Every visible SIT control must be Wired, Disabled/Deferred, or Hidden.
Fake-success toast without backend success is forbidden.
Minimum Epic 12 Company/User persistence is pulled into W4 if those screens remain visible.
Epic 14, Epic 15, and Epic 16 surfaces must remain hidden or clearly deferred unless intentionally wired.

what_to_do: 1. Build a visible-control inventory from the actual frontend, not only docs. Cover nav, buttons, drawers, modals, upload controls, export controls, settings controls, and internal-console controls.
2. Classify each visible primary action as Wired, Disabled/Deferred, Hidden, or Fake Success. Treat Fake Success as a bug to fix.
3. For W4 proof path, make the minimum vertical slice usable or honestly deferred: Login, Dashboard, Companies, Users, AP/AR company settings, Templates/Configurator, Export.

4. Wire Company create/edit to real backend persistence if endpoints and schema exist. If backend support is missing and cannot be completed safely in this pass, disable/defer the action with clear UI wording and update W4 docs.

5. Wire User create/edit to real backend persistence if endpoints and schema exist. If backend support is missing and cannot be completed safely in this pass, disable/defer the action with clear UI wording and update W4 docs.
6. For AP/AR master data, ensure AP and AR are separated. Wire list/import if backend routes exist; otherwise make import/add actions visibly deferred instead of toast-success.

7. Preserve Epic 10 Export/Configurator fixes: Quick Export must use backend null-template preview/download; Template Export must send runtime column_overrides; Configurator tabs/actions must remain clickable.

8. Inspect Upload, Processing, Review Scan, Review Mapping, Internal Console, Cost Control, Audit Log, Settings, and any Epic 14/15/16-looking surfaces. If visible but not implemented, disable/defer/hide them clearly.
9. Add or update focused tests so regressions are caught by real clicks and API/network expectations where feasible. Do not rely only on static marker checks.
10. Update W4 docs with the final visible-control audit table and any explicit deferrals, keeping `W4-TASK-BOARD.md` acceptance rows current.
11. Produce a completion report for Codex/Copilot with changed files, local verification, remaining deferrals, and exact deploy handoff notes.

must_cover_surfaces.name: Login and session
must_cover_surfaces.expectation: Login/session behavior is real or the SIT proof path clearly states the credentialed review mode being used.

must_cover_surfaces.name: Dashboard
must_cover_surfaces.expectation: Dashboard either loads real/session-aware summary state or is visibly labeled as a shell; it must not block the proof path.

must_cover_surfaces.name: Companies
must_cover_surfaces.expectation: Add/Edit Company persists through backend and survives refresh/re-login, or the action is disabled/deferred with visible wording.

must_cover_surfaces.name: Company detail COA/AP/AR/settings
must_cover_surfaces.expectation: COA/AP/AR tabs are separate and honest. Import/add actions are real or clearly deferred; no fake-success toast.

must_cover_surfaces.name: Users
must_cover_surfaces.expectation: Add/Edit User persists through backend and survives refresh/re-login, or the action is disabled/deferred with visible wording.

must_cover_surfaces.name: Templates and Configurator
must_cover_surfaces.expectation: Configurator stays wired and clickable; clone/delete/row-grouping are either real or explicitly deferred.

must_cover_surfaces.name: Export
must_cover_surfaces.expectation: Quick Export and Template Export continue to call real backend endpoints with correct payloads.

must_cover_surfaces.name: Upload/Processing/Review
must_cover_surfaces.expectation: Visible upload/review controls either load real/fixture-labeled data or are visibly deferred; no dead-end success.

must_cover_surfaces.name: Internal and future-epic surfaces
must_cover_surfaces.expectation: Internal Console, Cost Control, Audit Log, Settings, Epic 14, Epic 15, and Epic 16 surfaces are wired, role-guarded, hidden, or deferred.

acceptance_criteria: A visible-control audit exists and covers all main nav surfaces plus primary actions.
No visible W4 proof-path action shows success unless the backend action succeeded.
Company add/edit and User add/edit are either persisted through backend with refresh/re-login proof or visibly deferred.
AP/AR company settings are separated and either wired or visibly deferred.
Export/Configurator backend wiring still passes focused tests after the product-shell changes.
Any future Epic 14/15/16 surface that remains visible is clearly deferred/hidden/role-guarded.
Local tests or real-click smoke checks are recorded.
W4 docs reflect the resulting truth and do not overclaim SIT completion.
The result is ready for Copilot to deploy through Openclaw and run live SIT proof.
recommended_local_checks: Playwright or focused real-click E2E covering nav -> Companies -> Users -> Templates -> Export
Focused backend/API tests for any endpoint added or changed
A grep/static check for toast-only success handlers in W4 proof-path controls
final_instruction_to_claude: Finish the repo-side work, not just the review. Make the SIT shell honest and locally verified, then hand Copilot a clear deployable state. Do not deploy.
